title: Geometric reducedness satisfies the five properties required of a formal fibre condition
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies that the property of being geometrically reduced over the base field satisfies the five formal properties (A) to (E) required of the property P used in the theory of formal fibres. The proof is a checklist: the first property is the definition, the second follows because reducedness is checked on local rings, the third from ascent of reducedness, the fourth from descent of reducedness, and the fifth from the standard result that geometric reducedness is insensitive to separable algebraic extensions of the base. Each property is dispatched by naming the exact source it follows from.
